name: Centro Papelero
description: Office and stationery distributor in Uruguay with an online store. Sells office supplies, school supplies, art supplies, paper products and toys. States delivery across the country within 24 hours of dispatch on business days, and free delivery in Montevideo above a stated amount.
description_es: Distribuidor de artículos de oficina y papelería en Uruguay con tienda online. Vende artículos de oficina, útiles escolares, arte, papeles y juguetes. Indica entregas en todo el país dentro de las 24 horas hábiles y envío gratis en Montevideo por encima de un monto indicado.

ships_to.notes: States delivery across the country; interior dispatch through agencies from Terminal Tres Cruces. Interior price not stated.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Customers can collect at the store at no cost, per the homepage.
